notes.title: Royalty Free-For-All is LIVE NOW on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173796/46de58351c21199f1b714d206143cc730f33ef9a.png"]
ROYALTY FREE-FOR-ALL IS LIVE ON KICKSTARTER!!


You heard that right—Royalty Free-For-All is on Kickstarter! Click the button above to find the campaign page.



Backers can receive incredible rewards like early playtest access, behind-the-scenes art books with developer commentary, and the highest of donations can even introduce new bonus fighters to the game!




[previewyoutube="QG0S1AWJlzQ;full"][/previewyoutube]


The campaign seeks to improve online modes, visual polish, and fund console ports! But stretch goals expand the game's content in phenomenal ways, including Arcade Mode, guest music by David Wise, Grant Kirkhope, and Evelyn Lark, and new fighters like....


There's an unbelievable amount of content inside the Kickstarter page — be sure to check it out right here!
